exposure: Intrathecal blocking anesthesia with fentanyl and bupivacaine
outcome: Time to first ambulation after delivery
Postpartum pelvic floor muscle strength score
cohort: The study included 80 puerperae undergoing natural delivery at the Department of Obstetrics of a hospital from December 2020 to December 2021.
finding: Intrathecal blocking anesthesia with fentanyl and bupivacaine provided better labour analgesia and a lower incidence of first-degree perineal laceration compared to a non-invasive delivery technique in puerperae undergoing natural delivery.
mod_finding: Intrathecal blocking anesthesia during natural delivery was found to significantly lower the possibility of postpartum perineal laceration.
